differences.reason: Preserve Swift async/await, Sendable, Foundation transport and existing documented gaps; see Docs/CoreV6Parity.md and PortingStatus.md.

The two lazy-schemas.test.ts cases require JavaScript import and Zod factory instrumentation. Swift parses provider options at request time without a Zod validator to cache. JavaScript workflow serialization symbols and the callable provider function are also outside the Swift surface. Swift uses production user-agent version 3.0.85 in place of the Vitest version mock.

Existing transcription errors expose the provider message through responseBody. Speech errors preserve the wire body and expose the normalized message separately. Swift has no API-error data field or raw HTTP reason phrase, so the new handler retains structured provider data in the wire JSON and uses Foundation's status description as the fallback. Existing transcription polls time out after 60 seconds and options are validated before upload.

The pre-existing transcription validator checks core result fields and top-level word timings. It does not validate every optional nested word, diarization and audio-intelligence value the upstream Zod schema checks, or run full completed-payload validation on intermediate polls. Those invalid fixture permutations are absent from the matching-release transcription suite.
